supersedes.reason: four-master reverse extraction cannot recover the hidden interface pixels

sourceCanvas.usage: immutable source inputs only; no central safety crop is applied to the registered package

registeredCanvas.calibration: one fixed per-component uniform scale and translation from the full native source; premultiplied-alpha Lanczos; transparent RGB set to zero

futureDisplayExport.rule: a future display export must derive from an accepted registered composition and must not decide whether a component is usable

standardHead.modelSourceUsage: historical evidence only; forbidden as a downstream generation reference or composition input
standardHead.nativeUsage: immutable A-gate source audit only; it is a close-up source, not the current full-body registration reference
standardHead.ownership: complete bald skull, face, ears, and downward neck only; no hair, beard, clothes, shoulders, or body

compatibility.registeredCandidate: 2 heads x 1 hair style x 1 outfit = 2 full-body zero-transform composites
compatibility.futureMatrix: 4 heads x 2 hair styles x 2 outfits x 4 beard states = 64 composites

gates.authorization: four calls consumed; this registration package is eligible for B-gate review but is not B-gate approval

alphaExtraction.scope: border-sampled chroma background alpha, partially transparent edge despill, and transparent-RGB zeroing only; no semantic mask, redraw, subject transform, or extraction from a complete character

validation: frozen source hashes and RGBA formats match the A/B recovery evidence
each registered layer is 1024x1536 RGBA with zero transparent RGB
each named component has exactly one fixed uniform calibration transform
both composites reuse the exact same calibrated hair and outfit files with no composition transform
repeat builds have identical decoded pixel hashes
manual review covers hairline, temples, ear roots, back neck, collar, face visibility, hands and feet
a future display crop cannot replace B-gate registration review
failureHandling: stop the current gate; preserve input, prompt, output, parameters, hashes, and interface failure; no retry or fallback without a new explicit checkpoint
